scope: First GPU dispatch wired into the real Deep2 inference engine (ModelGenieExecutor), covering the FP32 RoPE stage only.

what_changed.backend_selector: GpuRoPEEnabled() in src/modelgenie/ModelGenieExecutor.cpp reads RAWRXD_GPU_ROPE. Off by default, so existing behaviour is unchanged.
what_changed.integration_point: MlaDecompressFwd, the K_rope stage that produces the shared 64-dim rotary component of K_new. This is the same stage that was previously verified against the llama.cpp K_PE reference.
what_changed.kernel: VulkanCompute::ExecuteRoPE, now a real compute dispatch instead of the placeholder that performed no work (see RAWRXD_VULKAN_ROPE_CORRECTNESS_001).
what_changed.fallback: If Vulkan init or the dispatch fails, the CPU path runs and a diagnostic is printed. The KV cache is never populated from a partially failed dispatch.
what_changed.build: compile_ir_executor.bat now compiles and links src/vulkan_compute.cpp against the real Vulkan SDK, with the SDK include ordered first and RAWRXD_VULKAN_SDK_HEADER set so the local stub header forwards to the real one.

verification.test: 65-position teacher-forced decode of the certified sequence on DeepSeek-V2-Lite-Chat.Q4_K_M.gguf.
verification.baseline: The certified CPU logits from RAWRXD_DEEP2_DLL_EQUIVALENCE_001.
verification.interpretation: Enabling the GPU RoPE kernel changes no logit bit across all 65 positions, so it is a drop-in equivalent of the certified CPU stage. This is a stronger statement than agreement within a tolerance.
verification.execution_integrity: Both runs: TEACHER_FORCED_DECODE=PASS, TOKENS_PROCESSED=65, 300/300 operations per position.

honest_scope.but: Only the 64-element RoPE stage executes on the GPU. Every quantised linear projection, RMSNorm, attention score/softmax, V aggregation and MoE output still executes on the CPU.
honest_scope.consequence: RAWRXD_DEEP2_GPU_LAYER_001 remains blocked. This certificate proves the dispatch mechanism and the RoPE kernel inside the real engine, not Deep2 Layer 0 GPU inference.

remaining_for_layer_0_gpu: A GPU quantised-dot kernel (Q4_K/Q6_K x Q8_K) so the linear layers can run on device without dequantising the whole 10 GB model into FP32.
GPU RMSNorm and GPU attention score/softmax/V-aggregation kernels.
Backend selection covering all of the above, plus dispatch counters and a zero-silent-fallback assertion.
Then per-tensor Layer 0 parity against the CPU/reference baseline.
